_note: The order menu. tokens = pilot estimate (see docs/PRICING.md); every item is made by a maker agent, checked by a fresh blind tester for its subject and by Wilco's test-wise bots, and logged by the reporter.

items.label: Worksheet with answer key
items.detail: Practice that gets harder (3 levels), a student copy and a teacher copy with the key.

items.label: Guided notes
items.detail: Fill-in notes that follow your source, with a teacher copy.

items.label: Quiz with A/B versions
items.detail: 8–12 questions, two versions with the same skills, keys for both.

items.label: Unit test with A/B versions
items.detail: 20–30 questions with about 40% harder questions, two versions, keys and a skills map.

items.label: Study guide / review sheet
items.detail: One or two pages of what to know, with practice and a key.

items.label: Lesson slides
items.detail: A slide deck that follows your source, with speaker notes.

items.label: Review game
items.detail: A printable or projector review game (question cards or a board) with answers.

items.label: Rubric
items.detail: A rubric for a task or project, with student-friendly wording.

items.label: Project or lab packet
items.detail: Instructions, steps, a checklist and a rubric for a longer project or lab.

items.label: Whole unit pack
items.detail: Notes, a worksheet per lesson, a quiz, a review and a unit test with A/B versions.

extras.label: Sell-it-yourself guide (TPT)
extras.detail: How to list your pack on Teachers Pay Teachers, with the AI note to include.

extras.label: Set up my agents with my examples
extras.detail: Your agents read the examples you upload and follow your layout, wording and level. First time only.
